question_sw: Ninataka kusajili VAT — ninahitaji nyaraka zipi na TRA itachukua muda gani kusindika ombi langu?
answer_sw: Ili kusajili VAT na TRA unahitaji: (1) fomu ya usajili (ITX 101.01.E); (2) nakala ya cheti cha TIN; (3) uthibitisho wa mahali pa biashara kama vile mkataba wa pango; (4) nakala ya kitambulisho cha taifa au pasipoti ya mmiliki; (5) rekodi za mauzo zinazoonyesha mauzo yanayopita kizingiti cha TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12 au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6. Wasilisha fomu kwenye ofisi ya TRA au mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa e-filing. TRA inachakata maombi mengi ndani ya siku 14 za kazi.
question_en: I want to register for VAT — what documents does TRA require and how long does the application take?
answer_en: To register for VAT with TRA you need: (1) the registration form (ITX 101.01.E); (2) copy of TIN certificate; (3) proof of business premises such as a rental agreement; (4) copy of owner national ID or passport; (5) sales records showing turnover exceeding TZS 200,000,000 over 12 months or TZS 100,000,000 over 6 months. Submit at a TRA office or via the e-filing portal. TRA typically processes applications within 14 working days.

question_sw: Ninauza bidhaa online kupitia malipo ya simu — kuna VAT maalum kwa mauzo ya kidijitali (B2C)?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kuanzia tarehe 1 Septemba 2025, kiwango cha VAT kwa malipo ya kidijitali ya B2C (business-to-consumer) ni asilimia 16. Hii ni kiwango tofauti na kiwango cha kawaida cha asilimia 18. Hata hivyo, miongozo ya utekelezaji bado inasubiri tangazo rasmi la Kamishna Mkuu (CG). Thibitisha na TRA kabla ya kubadilisha jinsi unavyokata VAT kwenye mauzo yako ya kidijitali.
question_en: I sell goods online through mobile payments — is there a special VAT rate for digital B2C sales?
answer_en: Yes. From 1 September 2025, the VAT rate for B2C (business-to-consumer) digital payments is 16%. This differs from the standard 18% rate. However, implementation rules are still awaiting a formal notice from the Commissioner General (CG). Confirm with TRA before changing how you charge VAT on your digital sales.
next_review_trigger: After Commissioner General issues B2C e-payment VAT implementation notice

question_sw: Je, mwanachama wa VICOBA analipa kodi kwa faida za mkopo wa VICOBA?
answer_sw: Matibabu ya kodi ya mapato ya VICOBA na faida za mkopo wake ni suala ambalo halijajadiliwa wazi katika kanuni za TRA za kawaida. VICOBA ni mfumo wa akiba wa jamii ambao mara nyingi unaonekana kama wa kibinafsi. Sina uhakika wa mwelekeo wa kodi wa sasa kwa VICOBA. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Does a VICOBA member pay tax on VICOBA loan income?
answer_en: The tax treatment of VICOBA income and loan returns is a matter not clearly addressed in standard TRA regulations. VICOBA is a community savings system often treated as informal. I am not certain of the current tax position on VICOBA. Verify with TRA.

question_sw: Je, biashara ya simu (phone credit / airtime) inahitaji EFD?
answer_sw: Biashara ya kuuza airtime (simu za prepaid) iliyosajiliwa kwa VAT inahitaji EFD. Hata hivyo, mengi ya mawakala wa kuuza airtime (airtime resellers) wanafanya kazi kwa mfumo wa wakala ambapo wanauza bidhaa za kampuni za simu — hali yao ya VAT/EFD inategemea muundo wa biashara na mauzo ya jumla. Kama mauzo yako yanazidi kizingiti cha VAT, usajili na EFD ni lazima. Wasiliana na TRA.
question_en: Does an airtime/phone credit business need an EFD?
answer_en: An airtime (prepaid phone credit) business that is VAT-registered requires EFD. However, many airtime resellers operate as agents selling telecom company products — their VAT/EFD status depends on business structure and total sales. If your sales exceed the VAT threshold, VAT registration and EFD are mandatory. Contact TRA for your specific situation.

question_sw: Ada za usajili wa BRELA kwa kampuni mpya ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Ada za usajili wa BRELA zinatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni na mtaji ulioandikishwa. Kwa kampuni za ndani (private/public limited companies), ada inategemea mtaji wa hisa ulioandikishwa — kampuni za mtaji mdogo (chini ya TZS 1,000,000) zinalipa ada tofauti na kampuni za mtaji mkubwa. Pia kuna ada ya usajili wa jina la biashara (business name), ushirika (partnership), na kampuni za kigeni (foreign companies). Nenda moja kwa moja kwenye tovuti ya BRELA (brela.go.tz) au ofisi ya BRELA kwa jedwali la sasa la ada kwani zinaweza kubadilika mwaka hadi mwaka.
answer_en: BRELA registration fees vary based on the type of company and registered share capital. For domestic companies (private/public limited companies), the fee depends on the registered share capital — companies with small capital (below TZS 1,000,000) pay different fees from large-capital companies. There are also fees for business name registration, partnerships, and foreign companies. Go directly to the BRELA website (brela.go.tz) or BRELA office for the current fee schedule as fees may change year to year.
question_en: What are the BRELA registration fees for a new company?

question_sw: Je, biashara ya jumla (wholesale) imekatazwa kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: NDIYO — biashara ya jumla (wholesale) iko katika orodha ya biashara 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A. Mgeni anayeendesha biashara ya jumla — kuuza bidhaa kwa maduka, wafanyabiashara wengine, au kwa wingi — anakiuka GN 487A na anastahili adhabu kamili: faini ya angalau TZS 10M, kifungo, na visa kufutwa.
question_en: Is wholesale trade prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A?
answer_en: YES — wholesale trade is on the list of 15 business categories prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A. A non-citizen running a wholesale business — selling goods to shops, other traders, or in bulk — is violating GN 487A and is subject to the full penalty: fine of at least TZS 10M, imprisonment, and visa revocation.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A prohibited category list

question_sw: WHT ya asilimia 10 inatumika kwa malipo ya riba na gawio — je, mwajiri anapaswa kukata kiasi kimoja kwa aina zote mbili?
answer_sw: Ndiyo kwa kiwango — WHT ya asilimia 10 inatumika kwa riba na gawio zote mbili. Hata hivyo, zinawasilishwa kwa mstari tofauti katika fomu ya WHT return ili TRA iweze kufuatilia kila aina. Mwajiri atakata asilimia 10 kwa kila malipo lakini ataripoti kila aina tofauti.
question_en: WHT of 10% applies to both interest and dividend payments — should an employer deduct the same amount for both types?
answer_en: Yes on the rate — 10% WHT applies to both interest and dividends. However, they are reported on separate lines in the WHT return form so TRA can track each type. The employer deducts 10% on each payment but reports each category separately.

instruction: VAT withholding ya 6% ya huduma — inalipwa TRA lini?
output: Qualifying buyer anayechukua VAT withholding ya 6% ya huduma analipa TRA VAT withholding inalipwa TRA tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata — siku ile ile ya VAT return ya kawaida. Si siku 7. Thibitisha na TRA tra.go.tz. Hii ni tofauti na kuwasilisha VAT return ya kawaida (tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata). VAT withholding inalipwa TRA tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata — siku ile ile ya VAT return ya kawaida. Si siku 7. Thibitisha na TRA tra.go.tz. Qualifying buyer ana wajibu mbili: (1) Kuweka withholding certificate; (2) Kutuma kiasi kilichokatwa TRA ndani ya muda uliowekwa. Kushindwa kutuma ni kosa la kodi kwa qualifying buyer. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Ninalipa kwa muuzaji wa bidhaa TZS 1,000,000 — ni kiasi gani cha pesa anachopata baada ya withholding?
output: Kama wewe ni qualifying buyer wa VAT na unanunua bidhaa: Withholding ya VAT = 3% ya bei (kabla ya VAT au ya bei yenye VAT — mwongozo wa TRA unathibitisha) ya TZS 1,000,000. Withholding = 3% × 1,000,000 = TZS 30,000. Muuzaji anapata: TZS 1,000,000 − TZS 30,000 = TZS 970,000. Kiasi kilichokatwa (TZS 30,000) unatuma TRA pamoja na withholding certificate. Muuzaji bado analazimika kuwasilisha VAT return yake — lakini TZS 30,000 tayari ipo TRA kwa niaba yake. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa hesabu sahihi.

question_sw: Ninaoa mwanawake wa China — baada ya ndoa ninaweza kufanya biashara ya rejareja kwa haki zake za ndoa?
answer_sw: Hapana — ndoa na raia wa Tanzania haibadilishi hadhi ya kisheria ya mwenza wa ndoa chini ya GN 487A. Mwanawake wa China anabaki 'mgeni' (non-citizen) hata baada ya ndoa na Mtanzania. GN 487A inaangalia URAIA wa biashara, si hali ya ndoa. Njia pekee ya kubadilisha hadhi ni kupata uraia wa Tanzania kupitia mchakato wa kisheria — si kupitia ndoa haraka.
question_en: I am marrying a Chinese woman — after marriage can she conduct retail trade using her marriage rights?
answer_en: No — marriage to a Tanzanian citizen does not change a spouse's legal status under GN 487A. A Chinese woman remains a 'non-citizen' even after marrying a Tanzanian. GN 487A looks at CITIZENSHIP for business, not marital status. The only way to change status is to obtain Tanzanian citizenship through the legal process — not through marriage alone.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Adhabu ya kutotumia EFD Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Kutotumia EFD kwa biashara iliyosajiliwa kwa VAT kunaweza kusababisha: adhabu ya kutotoa risiti kwa kila muamala uliokosekana, kusimamishwa kwa leseni ya biashara, kusimamishwa kwa usajili wa VAT, tathmini ya VAT ya malimbikizo kwa kipindi chote, na adhabu za ziada za kodi. TRA inaweza pia kuwasilisha kesi ya jinai kwa ukwepaji wa kodi unaoendelea. Mfumo wa EFD ulioundwa kuzuia ukwepaji — adhabu zake ni kali.
question_en: What are the penalties for not using EFD in Tanzania?
answer_en: Failure to use EFD for a VAT-registered business may result in: penalties per missed receipt transaction, suspension of business licence, suspension of VAT registration, backdated VAT assessments for the entire period, and additional tax penalties. TRA may also file criminal charges for ongoing tax evasion. The EFD system was designed to prevent evasion — its penalties are severe.

question_sw: Niliweza kupata unafuu wa adhabu kutoka TRA — taratibu ni zipi?
answer_sw: TRA inaweza kutoa unafuu wa adhabu (penalty remission) kwa sababu maalum kama: janga la asili, ugonjwa mbaya, au hali ya nguvu za mazingira (force majeure). Omba unafuu kwa maandishi kwa Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA ukieleza sababu. TRA itaangalia ombi na kutoa uamuzi. Hii si ya kawaida na inategemea hali halisi.
question_en: I may be able to get penalty relief from TRA — what is the procedure?
answer_en: TRA can grant penalty remission for specific reasons such as: natural disaster, serious illness, or force majeure. Apply for remission in writing to the TRA Commissioner General explaining the reasons. TRA will review the application and issue a decision. This is uncommon and depends on the actual circumstances.

question_sw: Usambazaji wa bidhaa nje ya Tanzania Bara unastahili VAT ya Tanzania?
answer_sw: Bidhaa zinazosambazwa au huduma zinazofurahiwa nje ya Tanzania Bara zinastahili kiwango cha sifuri (zero-rated) kwa kutoa uthibitisho. Hii inatofautiana na msamaha (exempt) — msajiliwa wa VAT anaweza kudai input tax credit kwa usambazaji wa zero-rated. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Is a supply consumed outside Tanzania Mainland subject to Tanzania VAT?
answer_en: Supplies consumed or enjoyed outside Tanzania Mainland are zero-rated upon proof. This differs from exempt — a VAT-registered person can claim input tax credit on zero-rated supplies. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Viwango vya PAYE Tanzania kwa 2025/2026 ni vipi?
answer_sw: Viwango vya PAYE Tanzania Bara (Finance Act 2025): TZS 0–270,000/mwezi: 0%; TZS 270,001–520,000: 8% ya ziada; TZS 520,001–760,000: 20% ya ziada + TZS 20,000; TZS 760,001–1,000,000: 25% ya ziada + TZS 68,000; zaidi ya TZS 1,000,000: 30% ya ziada + TZS 128,000. Thibitisha na TRA baada ya kila Finance Act.
question_en: What are the PAYE rates in Tanzania for 2025/2026?
answer_en: Tanzania Mainland PAYE bands (Finance Act 2025): TZS 0–270,000/month: 0%; TZS 270,001–520,000: 8% on excess; TZS 520,001–760,000: 20% on excess + TZS 20,000; TZS 760,001–1,000,000: 25% on excess + TZS 68,000; over TZS 1,000,000: 30% on excess + TZS 128,000. Confirm with TRA after each Finance Act.

instruction: Ninafanya biashara ndogo nyumbani kwa jina langu — BRELA inanishughulikia au la?
output: Inategemea jinsi unavyofanya biashara. Ukifanya biashara kwa jina lako kamili la kibinafsi tu bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria inaweza kukuruhusu bila usajili wa BRELA — lakini hii ni hali nadra na hatari kisheria. Ukitumia jina lolote la biashara — hata linalofanana na lako kama ’Mariamu Foods’ au ’Hassan Traders’ — LAZIMA usajili BRELA. Ushauri bora: sajili BRELA kwa hali zote — inakupa uhalali wa kisheria, uwezo wa kufungua akaunti ya benki, na ulinzi wa jina lako. Sheria ya biashara Tanzania Bara inamtaka kila mfanyabiashara asajili biashara yake — iwe jina lako la kwanza, la ukoo, au jina lolote linalofanana na lako. Biashara za nyumbani (home-based businesses) hazisamehewi — sheria haitofautishi kati ya biashara ya duka na biashara ya nyumba. Usajili wa BRELA unahitajika bila kujali mahali pa biashara.

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya stempu kwenye uhamishaji wa hisa za kampuni (share transfer) ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya stempu kwenye uhamishaji wa hisa ni asilimia 1 ya thamani ya hisa iliyoidhinishwa na bodi (the value of the shares as approved by the Board). Hii inatumika kwa hisa za kampuni zilizosajiliwa Tanzania, hati za deni (debentures), na faida inayohusiana na hati za amana, bima, au dhamana. Mwuzaji wa hisa kwa kawaida ndiye anayebeba wajibu wa kulipa kodi ya stempu, isipokuwa pande mbili zikubaliane vinginevyo.
answer_en: The stamp duty rate on share transfers is 1% of the value of the shares as approved by the Board. This applies to shares in Tanzanian registered companies, debentures, and interests secured by bonds, mortgage deeds, or insurance policies. The seller of the shares is typically the party bearing the stamp duty obligation unless the two parties agree otherwise.
question_en: What is the stamp duty rate on a company share transfer?
primary_source_name: TRA Stamp Duty Act Cap.189 — share transfer schedule

question_sw: GN 487A inazuia wageni wafanye kazi Tanzania — hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Si sahihi kamili. GN 487A inazuia wageni KUMILIKI au KUENDESHA biashara katika makundi 15 maalum — si kufanya kazi kwa ujumla. Wageni wanaweza bado kufanya kazi kama wafanyakazi wa kampuni kwa vibali vya kazi sahihi. Amri inalenga watu binafsi wasio raia wanaoendesha biashara zao wenyewe katika makundi yaliyozuiliwa, kama vile maduka ya rejareja, saluni, ukarabati wa simu, au uhamisho wa pesa. Vibali vya kazi kwa wafanyakazi wa kampuni ni suala tofauti linaloshughulikiwa na Sheria ya Ajira.
question_en: GN 487A bans foreigners from working in Tanzania — is this correct?
answer_en: Not entirely correct. GN 487A prohibits non-citizens from OWNING or OPERATING businesses in 15 specific categories — not from working in general. Foreigners can still work as employees with valid work permits. The Order targets individual non-citizens running their own businesses in the prohibited categories, such as retail shops, salons, phone repair, or mobile money. Work permits for company employees are a separate matter governed by Employment Law.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

instruction: Kwa mazoezi ya wafanyakazi wapya, tunaweza kupiga risiti za 'mazoezi' kwenye EFD halisi?
output: HAPANA — risiti za mazoezi (test receipts) kwenye EFD halisi ni hatari sana. Kila risiti inayopigwa kwenye EFD halisi inaenda kwenye TIMS ya TRA — risiti za mazoezi zinaweza kuonekana kama mauzo halisi na kuleta tatizo la kodi. Kwa mafunzo: tumia EFD ya ziada (dummy device) au omba TRA kwa utaratibu rasmi wa mafunzo.

instruction: Nguo za mitumba zinaingizwa Tanzania — je, zinapaswa kulipa ushuru gani wa forodha?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ushuru wa forodha kwa nguo za mitumba (second-hand clothing) unaweza kuhusisha import duty, excise duty, na VAT — lakini ukokotoaji wake wa forodha uko nje ya wigo wangu wa mada. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT ya biashara ya ndani, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na sheria za biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na TRA Customs and Excise kupitia tra.go.tz kwa jibu sahihi.

question_sw: Je, SDL inaathiri PAYE ya mfanyakazi?
answer_sw: Hapana. SDL (Skills and Development Levy) inalipwa na mwajiri kutoka mfuko wake mwenyewe — haikimuzi mfanyakazi. SDL haifanyi mabadiliko kwenye msingi wa PAYE wa mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Does SDL affect an employee's PAYE calculation?
answer_en: No. SDL (Skills and Development Levy) is paid by the employer from their own funds — it is not deducted from the employee. SDL does not change the employee's PAYE base. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kibali cha kazi Tanzania kinahuisha kiotomatiki kila mwaka — mwajiri hahitaji kufanya chochote — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kibali cha kazi HAIJUISHI kiotomatiki. Mwajiri lazima AOMBE uhuishaji kikamilifu angalau miezi 3 kabla ya kumalizika kwa kibali. Kutoomba kwa wakati kunaweza kusababisha mfanyakazi wa kigeni kuwa na hali ya haramu. Mwajiri ana wajibu wa kufuatilia tarehe za mwisho za vibali vyote vya wafanyakazi wake.
question_en: A Tanzania work permit auto-renews every year — the employer doesn't need to do anything — is this true?
answer_en: No. Work permits do NOT auto-renew. The employer must ACTIVELY APPLY for renewal at least 3 months before the permit expires. Failing to apply on time can leave the foreign worker in an unlawful status. The employer has a responsibility to track all their workers' permit expiry dates.

instruction: Je, mwanachama mdogo wa kampuni (hisa 5%) anaweza kushikiliwa kwa madeni ya kampuni?
output: Kwa kawaida hapana. Hii ndiyo faida ya limited company: wanahisa wanashikiliwa tu kwa kiasi cha hisa walizowekeza. Mwanachama mwenye hisa 5% anashikiliwa tu kwa thamani ya hisa hizo — si kwa madeni yote ya kampuni. Hata hivyo, kama mwanachama huyo ni mkurugenzi pia na alifanya vitendo vya ulaghai au alikuwa na dhamana ya kibinafsi — ndipo anaweza kushikiliwa zaidi. Hii ndiyo sababu limited liability ni faida kubwa ya kampuni ya hisa. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara.

instruction: PAYE na kodi ya mapato (income tax) ni vitu tofauti au ni kitu kimoja?
output: PAYE (Pay As You Earn) NI kodi ya mapato — ni njia ya kukusanya kodi ya mapato ya mfanyakazi. Tofauti ya vitendo: PAYE: mwajiri anakata kodi na kuipeleka TRA kila mwezi (tarehe 7). Income Tax ya binafsi: mtu anajilipia mwenyewe (self-employed, wawekezaji). Kwa wafanyakazi wa kawaida: PAYE ndiyo kodi yao yote ya mapato — hawalazimiki kuwasilisha tax return tofauti kama mwajiri amewapiga PAYE sahihi.

question_sw: Ni lini mwajiri analazimika kuunda kamati ya usalama (safety committee)?
answer_sw: Mwajiri mwenye wafanyakazi 20 au zaidi analazimika kuunda kamati ya usalama na afya kazini. Kamati hii lazima ikutane mara kwa mara na kuhakikisha usalama mahali pa kazi unashughulikiwa.
question_en: When is an employer required to establish a safety committee?
answer_en: An employer with 20 or more employees must establish an occupational safety and health committee. The committee must meet regularly and ensure workplace safety matters are addressed.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Wanunuzi wanaohitimu wangu hawajui wana jukumu la withholding. Niwasaiduje?
output: Waambie: wanunuzi wanaohitimu (qualifying buyers) wana wajibu wa kisheria wa kukata VAT. Wizara, benki, na makampuni ya simu yaliyoteuliwa ni mifano. Wajibu wao: (1) kutoa certificate ya withholding kwa kila msambazaji; (2) kupeleka VAT iliyokatwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 20; (3) kuwasilisha VAT return yao wenyewe. Kama hawajui, waelekeze TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Je, VAT Zanzibar ni sawa na Tanzania Bara?
answer_sw: Hapana, Zanzibar ina mfumo wake tofauti wa ushuru. Ninashughulikia maswali ya Tanzania Bara (Mainland) tu — mfumo wa TRA. Zanzibar ina Zanzibar Revenue Authority (ZRA) yenye sheria na viwango tofauti. Kwa maswali ya Zanzibar, wasiliana na ZRA. Je, una swali kuhusu VAT Tanzania Bara? Kiwango cha VAT Tanzania Bara ni asilimia 18.
question_en: Is Zanzibar VAT the same as Mainland Tanzania?
answer_en: No, Zanzibar has its own separate tax system. I handle Mainland Tanzania (TRA) questions only. Zanzibar has the Zanzibar Revenue Authority (ZRA) with different laws and rates. For Zanzibar questions, contact ZRA. Do you have a question about Mainland Tanzania VAT? The Mainland VAT rate is 18%.

instruction: Mchanga wa bahari unauchimbwa pwani — royalty ya nini Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Royalties za rasilimali asilia (madini, mchanga, mawe, na kadhalika) zinaamuliwa na Sheria ya Madini na mfumo wa kisheria wa Wizara ya Madini — nje ya wigo wangu wa compliance ya biashara ya kawaida. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na sheria za biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na Wizara ya Madini au mshauri maalum kwa jibu sahihi.

instruction: Wataalamu wa hesabu (wahasibu) na mawakili — lazima wasajiliwe VAT?
output: Ndiyo, wataalamu wa hesabu (wahasibu), mawakili, na watoa huduma za kitaalamu wanaofanya biashara Tanzania wanalazimika kusajiliwa VAT kama mapato yao yanafika kizingiti. Zaidi ya hayo, TRA inaweza kuwataka wasajiliwe hata kabla ya kizingiti kama aina ya biashara yao inabainishwa. Wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) ili kujua kama kazi yako maalum ina masharti ya ziada.

instruction: Msimamizi mkuu (senior manager) mwenye TZS 1,500,000 kwa mwezi — nionyeshe PAYE kamili.
output:
Hesabu ya PAYE kwa TZS 1,500,000/mwezi:
Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 270,000 = TZS 0
Bendi 2 (8%): TZS 250,000 × 8% = TZS 20,000
Bendi 3 (20%): TZS 240,000 × 20% = TZS 48,000
Bendi 4 (25%): TZS 240,000 × 25% = TZS 60,000
Bendi 5 (30%): TZS 500,000 × 30% = TZS 150,000
PAYE ya jumla: TZS 278,000/mwezi
TZS 500,000 ya ziada juu ya TZS 1,000,000 iko Bendi 5 (30%) = TZS 150,000.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya usajili wa OSHA na usajili wa WCF ni nini?
answer_sw: Usajili wa OSHA unahusu USALAMA mahali pa kazi — ukaguzi, viwango vya usalama, na cheti cha OSHA. Usajili wa WCF unahusu BIMA ya ajali — malipo ya mfanyakazi aliyeumia. Zote mbili zinahitajika lakini zina taratibu tofauti, ada tofauti, na mashirika tofauti.
question_en: What is the difference between OSHA registration and WCF registration?
answer_en: OSHA registration is about workplace SAFETY — inspections, safety standards, and OSHA certificate. WCF registration is about accident INSURANCE — payments to injured workers. Both are required but have separate processes, separate fees, and separate organisations.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: GN 487A inahusu vibali vya kazi au ni agizo tofauti?
answer_sw: GN 487A na vibali vya kazi ni vitu viwili tofauti. Kibali cha kazi kinaruhusu mgeni kufanya kazi kwa mwajiri. GN 487A, kwa upande wake, kinakataza raia wa kigeni kufanya shughuli MAALUM za biashara (kama biashara ya rejareja, salon) bila kujali kama wana kibali cha kazi au la. Hata mgeni mwenye kibali halisi cha kazi hawezi kufanya biashara zilizozuiwa chini ya GN 487A.
question_en: Is GN 487A about work permits or is it a separate order?
answer_en: GN 487A and work permits are two separate things. A work permit allows a foreigner to work for an employer. GN 487A separately prohibits foreign nationals from conducting SPECIFIC business activities (such as retail trade, salons) regardless of whether they hold a work permit. Even a foreigner with a valid work permit cannot engage in activities prohibited under GN 487A.

question_sw: Ninapaswa kumripoti vipi mgeni anayefanya biashara iliyozuiliwa katika mtaa wangu?
answer_sw: Unaweza kuripoti mgeni anayefanya biashara iliyozuiliwa chini ya GN 487A kwa njia zifuatazo: (1) Idara ya Uhamiaji ya mkoa wako au wilaya yako, (2) Polisi wa biashara (Business Intelligence Unit), (3) BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) — ofisi za mkoa, (4) Namba ya dharura ya Uhamiaji ikiwa inapatikana mkoa wako. Utoa taarifa kwa jina au bila jina. Kwa ujumla, inapendekezwa kwamba kwanza ujaribu kutoa ushauri wa kirafiki kwa mgeni huyo kabla ya kuripoti, ili apate nafasi ya kufuata sheria bila kuathiri maisha yake. Lakini ikiwa tatizo linaendelea, kuripoti ni haki yako ya kisheria.
question_en: How do I report a non-citizen operating a prohibited business in my neighbourhood?
answer_en: You can report a non-citizen operating a prohibited business under GN 487A through: (1) The Immigration Department in your region or district, (2) Business Intelligence Unit of Police, (3) BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) — regional offices, (4) Immigration emergency number if available in your region. Reports can be made with or without giving your name. Generally, it is advisable to first try offering friendly advice to the non-citizen so they have a chance to comply without disrupting their life. But if the problem continues, reporting is your legal right.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: SDL inalipiwa wafanyakazi moja kwa moja au inakwenda serikalini?
answer_sw: SDL inakwenda serikalini — hasa TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority). Haiendi moja kwa moja kwa wafanyakazi. TRA inaitumia kusaidia VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) na programu za mafunzo. Mfanyakazi hupata manufaa kwa njia ya mafunzo ya umma, si malipo ya moja kwa moja.
question_en: Is SDL paid directly to employees or does it go to the government?
answer_en: SDL goes to the government — specifically TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority). It is not paid directly to employees. TRA uses it to support VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) and training programmes. Employees benefit through public training, not direct payments.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Mkenya anayeendesha salon ya nywele Dar es Salaam, mkahawa mdogo, na huduma za M-Pesa — ni ipi kati ya hizi inayokiuka GN 487A?
answer_sw: ZOTE TATU zinakiuka GN 487A. (1) Salon ya nywele — ipo kwenye orodha ya biashara zilizopigwa marufuku. (2) Mkahawa mdogo wa chakula — HAIKO kwenye orodha kama kategoria iliyotajwa wazi katika GN 487A. Hata hivyo, kama inahusisha uuzaji wa bidhaa kwa rejareja inaweza kuangukia chini ya Kategoria 1 (biashara ya rejareja). Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji. (3) Wakala wa M-Pesa/huduma za uhamisho wa pesa za simu — ipo kwenye orodha. Mkenya (au mgeni yeyote asiye raia wa Tanzania) anayefanya biashara hizi tatu anakiuka GN 487A kwa makosa matatu tofauti.
question_en: A Kenyan national runs a hair salon in Dar es Salaam, a small food outlet, and M-Pesa services — which of these violates GN 487A?
answer_en: ALL THREE violate GN 487A. (1) Hair salon — is on the list of prohibited businesses. (2) Small food outlet — is NOT explicitly named in the GN 487A Schedule. However, if it involves retail sale of goods it may fall under Category 1 (retail trade). Verify with Immigration. (3) M-Pesa agent/mobile money transfer services — is on the list. A Kenyan (or any non-Tanzanian citizen) running all three of these businesses is violating GN 487A for three separate offences.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: TRA ina muda gani wa kisheria wa kutoa tathmini ya kodi baada ya mwaka wa kodi kupita?
answer_sw: Chini ya Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato na sheria za kodi nyingine Tanzania, TRA kwa ujumla ina miaka 5 kuanzia tarehe ya mwisho ya kuwasilisha return ya kodi kuwasilisha tathmini dhidi ya mlipa kodi ambaye aliwasilisha return. Kwa mlipa kodi ambaye hakuwasilisha return kabisa, TRA inaweza kutoa tathmini wakati wowote — hakuna kikomo cha muda. Kwa udanganyifu au ukwepaji wa makusudi, muda huo unaweza kuwa mrefu zaidi. Hifadhi rekodi zako za uhasibu kwa angalau miaka 5 ili kujibu tathmini yoyote ndani ya muda huo.
answer_en: Under the Income Tax Act and other Tanzanian tax laws, TRA generally has 5 years from the date of the final deadline for filing a tax return to issue an assessment against a taxpayer who filed a return. For a taxpayer who did not file a return at all, TRA may issue an assessment at any time — there is no time limit. For fraud or deliberate evasion, the period may be longer. Keep your accounting records for at least 5 years to be able to respond to any assessment within this period.
question_en: What is the statutory time limit for TRA to issue a tax assessment after the tax year has passed?
primary_source_name: TRA — limitation period for tax assessments
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment to limitation period

question_sw: Mgeni anafanya biashara Tanzania — anahitaji nini chini ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Chini ya GN 487A (2025), mgeni hawezi kufanya biashara katika makundi 15 yaliyozuiliwa hata akiwa na vibali vyote vya biashara na makazi. Makundi yaliyozuiliwa yanajumuisha: biashara ya jumla na rejareja, huduma za uhamisho wa pesa kwa simu, ukarabati wa simu, saluni na kinyozi, ubadilishaji wa fedha za kigeni, uendeshaji wa kituo cha mafuta, huduma za madalali, na mengine. Kama mgeni anataka kufanya biashara nchini Tanzania, lazima afanye kwa njia ya ubia na raia wa Tanzania au kufanya biashara katika sekta ambazo hazijazuiliwa. Mshauri wa kisheria ni muhimu.
question_en: A foreigner wants to do business in Tanzania — what do they need under GN 487A?
answer_en: Under GN 487A (2025), a non-citizen cannot operate businesses in the 15 prohibited categories even with all valid business and residence permits. Prohibited categories include: wholesale and retail trade, mobile money transfer services, phone repair, salons and barbershops, forex bureaus, petrol station operations, brokerage services, and others. If a non-citizen wants to do business in Tanzania, they must do so through a partnership with a Tanzanian citizen or operate in non-restricted sectors. Legal advice is essential.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Kampuni inayomilikiwa na Serikali (parastatal) inalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla ndiyo — taasisi zinazomilikiwa na Serikali (parastatals) kama TANESCO, TPA, na NMB zinazolipa mishahara ya wafanyakazi zinatakiwa kulipa SDL kama mwajiri mwingine yeyote, isipokuwa zitakazokuwa zimepata msamaha maalum kutoka TRA. Waajiri wote wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi wanalipa SDL ya 3.5% ya mishahara ya jumla. Hali ya kila parastatal inaweza kutofautiana — thibitisha na TRA kwa shirika lako maalum.
answer_en: Generally yes — government-owned institutions (parastatals) such as TANESCO, TPA, and NMB that pay employee salaries are required to pay SDL like any other employer, unless they have received a specific exemption from TRA. All employers with 10 or more employees pay SDL at 3.5% of gross payroll. Each parastatal's situation may vary — confirm with TRA for your specific organisation.
question_en: Does a government-owned company (parastatal) pay SDL?
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA circular

instruction: Biashara yangu ndogo inapomuuzia mtu bidhaa ya TZS 500 tu — ninatakiwa kutoa risiti ya EFD?
output: Ndiyo — EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) inatakiwa kwa KILA muamala wa biashara, bila kujali kiasi. Sheria ya EFD haisemi 'kiasi cha chini' — hata muamala wa TZS 100 unahitaji risiti ya EFD kama unaendesha biashara iliyolazimika kutumia EFD. TRA inatekeleza hii kwa ukali. Kukosa kutoa risiti — hata kwa muamala mdogo — ni kosa linalohatarisha faini, kufungwa kwa biashara, na uchunguzi wa ukaguzi wa kina. Kumbuka: risiti ya EFD inatolewa SIKU ILE ILE ya muamala — si kesho. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz). Kumbuka: EFD inahitajika kwa biashara zenye mauzo ya TZS milioni 11 au zaidi kwa mwaka, au biashara zote zilizosajiliwa VAT bila kujali kiasi. Biashara zenye mauzo chini ya TZS milioni 11 zinaweza kutumia risiti za kawaida isipokuwa zimesajiliwa VAT. Thibitisha na TRA tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Mhandisi ana ofisi ya kibinafsi na pia ana kazi ya mshahara serikalini. Je, anahitaji kusajili VAT kwa ofisi yake binafsi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — hata kama mhandisi ana kazi ya mshahara serikalini, ofisi yake ya kibinafsi (consultancy) inastahili usajili wa VAT kwa sababu ana leseni ya kitaalamu ya ERB. Shughuli mbili tofauti: kazi ya mshahara (kodi inazingatiwa na mwajiri) na ofisi binafsi (lazima asimamie mwenyewe kodi ikiwa ni pamoja na VAT). Mapato yote ya ofisi binafsi lazima yaorodheshwe kwa TRA.
question_en: An engineer has a private office and also salaried government employment. Do they need to register for VAT for their private office?
answer_en: Yes — even if an engineer is salaried in government, their private office (consultancy) requires VAT registration because they hold an ERB professional licence. Two separate activities: salaried employment (tax managed by employer) and private office (must manage own taxes including VAT). All private office income must be declared to TRA.

question_sw: Mhesabu wangu alisema bendi ya 2 ya PAYE ni asilimia 9. Je, ana haki?
answer_sw: Hapana — mhesabu wako ana kosa. Bendi ya pili ya PAYE Tanzania ni asilimia 8 (si 9). Kosa hili la asilimia 9 linaonekana mara kwa mara katika mifumo ya kuandikia mishahara ya zamani na vitabu vya kodi visivyosasishwa. Kiwango sahihi: TZS 270,001-520,000 = 8%. Ikiwa mhesabu wako anatumia 9%, mfanyakazi wako analipa PAYE zaidi ya inayostahili — unastahili kurekebisha mfumo wako wa mishahara.
question_en: My accountant said PAYE band 2 is 9%. Are they correct?
answer_en: No — your accountant is mistaken. The second PAYE band in Tanzania is 8% (not 9%). This 9% error appears frequently in outdated payroll systems and uncorrected tax references. The correct rate: TZS 270,001-520,000 = 8%. If your accountant is using 9%, your employees are paying more PAYE than they should — you should correct your payroll system.

question_sw: Je, kila mfanyabiashara aliyesajiliwa VAT anaweza kudai refund?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — mfanyabiashara YEYOTE aliyesajiliwa VAT ambaye ana ziada ya input VAT juu ya output VAT ana haki ya kudai refund. Hii si haki maalum kwa makampuni makubwa peke yake. Biashara ndogo pia zinaweza kudai kama zinaonyesha input VAT inayostahili iliyolipwa.
question_en: Can every VAT-registered business claim a refund?
answer_en: Yes — ANY VAT-registered business that has excess input VAT over output VAT is entitled to claim a refund. This is not a special right for large companies alone. Small businesses can also claim if they demonstrate eligible paid input VAT.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

instruction: Mgeni wa China alikuwa akifanya ukarabati wa simu — polisi wamesema watamlazimisha kulipa faini NA kukaa gerezani. Je, hii ni sahihi kisheria?
output: Hapana — muundo huu si sahihi kisheria chini ya GN 487A. Adhabu ni faini AU kifungo — si zote mbili kwa wakati mmoja kwa kosa moja. Korti ndiyo inayoamua kama atatoa faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6. Polisi haiwezi kuamua hilo — ni uamuzi wa mahakama. Hata hivyo, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na wakili.

question_sw: NSSF inalipwa ndani ya muda gani baada ya mwisho wa mwezi?
answer_sw: Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya NSSF Kifungu cha 12, mchango wa NSSF unapaswa kulipwa ndani ya mwezi mmoja (within one month) baada ya mwisho wa mwezi husika. Thibitisha tarehe halisi na NSSF kwani sheria inaweza kusomwa tofauti na mazoea ya vitendo.
question_en: Within what period must NSSF contributions be paid after the end of the month?
answer_en: Under the NSSF Act Section 12, contributions must be paid within one month after the end of the relevant month. Confirm the exact deadline with NSSF as the law may be interpreted differently from practical arrangements.

question_sw: Je, serikali na taasisi zake zinastahili VAT Tanzania?
answer_sw: Serikali na taasisi zake zinaweza kuwa wasajiliwa wa VAT kama zinafanya shughuli za kiuchumi. Pia zinaweza kuwa wakala wa zuio ya VAT. Thibitisha hali halisi ya shughuli za taasisi husika na TRA.
question_en: Are government entities and institutions subject to VAT in Tanzania?
answer_en: Government entities and institutions may be VAT registrants if they carry on economic activities. They may also serve as VAT withholding agents. Confirm the specific situation for the institution concerned with TRA.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kumfuta mfanyakazi anayekataa kufanya kazi yenye hatari — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kufuta mfanyakazi kwa kukataa kufanya kazi yenye hatari ya haraka ni KINYUME na Sheria ya OSHA na Sheria ya Ajira na Mahusiano ya Kazini (ELRA). Wafanyakazi wana haki ya kulindwa kufanya kazi yenye hatari ya haraka ya kifo au majeraha makubwa bila kulipizwa kisasi.
question_en: An employer can dismiss an employee who refuses to perform dangerous work — is this true?
answer_en: No. Dismissing an employee for refusing to perform work with an imminent hazard is ILLEGAL under both the OSHA Act and the Employment and Labour Relations Act (ELRA). Workers have a protected right to refuse imminently dangerous work without facing retaliation.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Mtanzania anaomba mgeni 'changa' tu kwa ajili ya usajili — si mmiliki halisi. Hii ni tatizo?
answer_sw: Ndiyo — hii ni aina nyingine ya 'kuwezesha'. Hata kama Mtanzania anasema yeye ni 'mmiliki' rasmi na mgeni ni 'mchangiaji' tu, ikiwa mgeni ndiye anayeendesha biashara halisi, ana maamuzi, na anapata faida — hali hii inachukuliwa ukiukaji wa GN 487A. Sheria inaangalia hali halisi ya biashara, si mikataba ya uwongo. Mtanzania anakuwa msaidizi na ana hatari ya adhabu.
question_en: A Tanzanian asks a non-citizen to 'just contribute funds' for registration — not the real owner. Is this a problem?
answer_en: Yes — this is another form of 'facilitating'. Even if a Tanzanian claims to be the formal 'owner' and the non-citizen is just a 'contributor', if the non-citizen is actually running the real business, making decisions, and receiving profits — this situation is treated as a GN 487A violation. The law looks at the real business substance, not fake contracts. The Tanzanian becomes a facilitator and faces penalty risk.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

instruction: SDL ni 3.5% ya mishahara ya fedha — mishahara ya aina nyingine (nyumba, gari) haihesabiwi?
output: Sahihi — SDL inakokotolewa kwa MALIPO YA FEDHA (cash payments) peke yake — si faida zisizo za fedha (benefits in kind). Kwa hiyo hizi zinaingia kwenye SDL base: Mshahara wa msingi (basic salary); Posho za fedha (housing allowance kama inalipwa kwa pesa taslimu); Bonasi za fedha; Malipo ya ziada ya saa (overtime). Hizi HAZIINGII kwenye SDL base: Nyumba ya kampuni (company house); Gari la kampuni (company car); Bima ya afya inayolipwa moja kwa moja (si kwa mfanyakazi); Chakula cha bure cha kampuni. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa miongozo kamili ya SDL base.

question_sw: TRA imeniandikia barua ya kodi ya ziada — nifanye nini kwanza?
answer_sw: Soma barua kwa makini. Kama ni tathmini ya kodi inayosema unadaiwa kiasi fulani, una siku 30 tu kupinga (objection). Kama hujui tathmini ni sahihi au la, peleka barua kwa mshauri wa kodi au akaunti haraka. Usikae bila kuchukua hatua — siku 30 zinapita haraka.
question_en: TRA has written me a letter about additional tax — what should I do first?
answer_en: Read the letter carefully. If it is a tax assessment stating you owe a certain amount, you have only 30 days to object. If you're not sure whether the assessment is correct, take the letter to a tax adviser or accountant quickly. Don't sit idle — 30 days passes fast.

instruction: SDL na PAYE — vinafanana vipi na vinatofauti vipi?
output: SDL na PAYE zinahusiana na wafanyakazi lakini ni tofauti kabisa: SDL (Skills Development Levy): Kiasi: 3.5% ya mishahara ya fedha ya wafanyakazi wote; Mlipaji: MWAJIRI peke yake — si kukatwa kwa mfanyakazi; Taasisi: TRA; Kizingiti: wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. PAYE (Pay As You Earn): Kiasi: inakatwa kwa viwango vya makundi ya mapato (0%–30%); Mlipaji: MFANYAKAZI ndiye anayebeba — mwajiri anakata na kutuma TRA; Taasisi: TRA; Kizingiti: mfanyakazi yeyote mwenye mapato yanayopita TZS 270,000/mwezi. Pia: SDL inatumika kwa JUMLA ya mishahara; PAYE inatumika KWA KILA MFANYAKAZI mmoja mmoja. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Rafiki yangu anasema Tanzania imepunguza VAT kwenda asilimia 5 mwaka 2025. Je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. VAT ya Tanzania haijapunguzwa kwenda asilimia 5 mwaka 2025 wala wakati wowote. Kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT Tanzania Bara ni asilimia 18, na kimekuwa hivyo tangu 2015. Finance Act 2025 ilipunguza kiwango cha SDL kutoka asilimia 4 hadi asilimia 3.5, lakini VAT ilibaki asilimia 18.
question_en: My friend says Tanzania reduced VAT to 5% in 2025. Is that true?
answer_en: No. Tanzania's VAT was not reduced to 5% in 2025 or at any other time. The standard VAT rate on Mainland Tanzania is 18%, and has been since 2015. Finance Act 2025 reduced the SDL rate from 4% to 3.5%, but VAT remained at 18%.

instruction: Nina duka la nguo lenye wafanyakazi 4 — OSHA inashughulikia duka langu?
output: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) inatumika kwa MAENEO YOTE ya kazi Tanzania — bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi. Duka lako lenye wafanyakazi 4 linashughulikiwa na OSHA — hakuna kizingiti cha ukubwa. Mahitaji yako: (1) Sajili eneo lako la kazi na OSHA. (2) Hakikisha mazingira ya kazi ni salama (mwanga, hewa, usafi). (3) Weka mipango ya dharura (emergency plan). Ukaguzi wa OSHA unaweza kufanyika wakati wowote bila taarifa.

question_sw: WHT inatumika kwa malipo ya ndani ya Tanzania peke yake — malipo kwa nchi za nje hayatozi WHT — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. WHT inatumika kwa MALIPO YA AINA ZOTE — ya ndani na ya nje. Kwa kweli, malipo ya nje (kwa wasio wakazi) mara nyingi yanatoza WHT ya kiwango cha JUU zaidi kuliko malipo ya ndani. Kwa mfano, ada za usimamizi kwa wasio wakazi ni asilimia 15 ikilinganishwa na asilimia 5 kwa wakazi.
question_en: WHT only applies to domestic Tanzania payments — payments abroad are not subject to WHT — is this true?
answer_en: No. WHT applies to ALL PAYMENT TYPES — both domestic and cross-border. In fact, cross-border payments (to non-residents) often attract HIGHER WHT rates than domestic payments. For example, management fees for non-residents are 15% compared to 5% for residents.

instruction: Kampuni yangu inanunua bidhaa na baadaye inalipa kwa awamu — withholding inatokea lini?
output: VAT withholding inatokea wakati malipo yanafanywa — kila awamu ya malipo inachukua 3% (bidhaa) au 6% (huduma) ya kiasi kinacholipwa. Kwa mfano: mlipaji hulipa TZS 1,000,000 mwezi wa kwanza na TZS 500,000 mwezi wa pili: withholding ya mwezi 1 = 3% × 1,000,000 = TZS 30,000; withholding ya mwezi 2 = 3% × 500,000 = TZS 15,000. Kila awamu ina withholding certificate yake. Muuzaji anapokea kila malipo pungufu ya withholding. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa mwongozo wa malipo ya awamu.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya ushuru wa stempu na ushuru wa usajili wa ardhi (land registration fee) Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Hizi ni ada mbili tofauti zinazolipwa wakati wa kununua ardhi Tanzania. Ushuru wa stempu (1% ya thamani) unalipwa kwa TRA na unahusiana na hati ya kisheria. Ada ya usajili wa ardhi ni ada tofauti inayolipwa kwa Msajili wa Ardhi (Registrar of Titles / MLHHSD) kwa kusajili hati hiyo kwenye rejista ya ardhi. Zote mbili zinahitajika kwa uhamishaji kamili wa kisheria wa ardhi.
question_en: What is the difference between stamp duty and land registration fee in Tanzania?
answer_en: These are two separate charges paid when buying land in Tanzania. Stamp duty (1% of value) is paid to TRA and relates to the legal instrument. The land registration fee is a separate fee paid to the Registrar of Titles (MLHHSD) to register that instrument in the land register. Both are required for full legal transfer of land.
next_review_trigger: Stamp Duty Act or land registration fee update

question_sw: Makubaliano ya malipo (payment plan) na TRA yanaweza kupata — taratibu ni zipi?
answer_sw: Kuomba makubaliano ya malipo na TRA: (1) wasiliana na TRA mapema kabla ya deni kuwa kubwa sana, (2) omba rasmi makubaliano ya malipo kwa maandishi ukieleza hali yako ya fedha, (3) wasilisha mapendekezo ya malipo ya awamu. TRA inaweza kukubali ikiwa una nia ya kweli ya kulipa.
question_en: How can a payment arrangement with TRA be obtained — what is the procedure?
answer_en: To request a payment arrangement with TRA: (1) contact TRA early before the debt becomes very large, (2) formally request a payment arrangement in writing explaining your financial situation, (3) submit a proposed instalment payment schedule. TRA may agree if you demonstrate genuine intent to pay.

instruction: Mfanyakazi wangu mpya anapata TZS 300,000 kwa mwezi — anafaa kulipa PAYE?
output:
Ndiyo — mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa TZS 300,000 kwa mwezi analipa PAYE ndogo. Hesabu ni kama ifuatavyo:

Kanda 1 (0%): TZS 0 hadi 270,000 — kodi = TZS 0
Kanda 2 (8%): TZS 270,001 hadi 300,000 — TZS 30,000 x 8% = TZS 2,400

Jumla ya PAYE = TZS 2,400 kwa mwezi.

Ingawa kiasi ni kidogo, PAYE inapaswa kukatwa na kuwasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Thibitisha na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Ninaacha mfanyakazi baada ya miezi 3 — NSSF yake inaenda wapi?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. NSSF ya mfanyakazi aliyeacha kazi: michango iliyokusanyika inabaki kwenye akaunti yake ya NSSF. Mfanyakazi anaweza kudai faida za NSSF anapofika umri wa kustaafu (60 kwa kawaida). Pia anaweza kudai faida za muda wa kati kama vile matibabu (kwa makampuni fulani). Mwajiri lazima atoe hati za NSSF kwa mfanyakazi anayeacha kazi.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu ana ulemavu — anapaswa kulipwa SDL?
answer_sw: Swali hili linachanganya mambo mawili tofauti. SDL si malipo ya wafanyakazi wenye ulemavu — ni ushuru wa mwajiri. Mwajiri analipa SDL kwa TRA kwa kiwango cha 3.5% ya mishahara yote, bila kujali hali ya kiafya ya wafanyakazi. Mfanyakazi mwenye ulemavu ana haki zake tofauti chini ya ELRA na WCF, lakini hizo hazihusiani na SDL.
question_en: My employee has a disability — should they be paid SDL?
answer_en: This question confuses two different things. SDL is not a payment to disabled employees — it is an employer levy. The employer pays SDL to TRA at 3.5% of total gross payroll, regardless of employees' health status. An employee with a disability has separate rights under ELRA and WCF, but those are unrelated to SDL.

question_sw: Kodi ya zuio ya malipo ya bidhaa kwa serikali Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Malipo ya bidhaa zinazotolewa kwa serikali na taasisi zake yanastahili kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 2 ya malipo ghafi. Hii inashughulikia wazabuni wote wanaouza bidhaa kwa serikali. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What withholding tax applies to payments for goods supplied to the government in Tanzania?
answer_en: Payments for goods supplied to the government and its institutions are subject to 2% withholding tax on gross payment. This applies to all suppliers selling goods to government entities. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Biashara yangu ndogo ina mapato ya TZS 80,000,000 — nitajua vipi ikiwa ninapaswa kutumia presumptive tax au mfumo wa kawaida?
answer_sw: Vigezo vya kuchagua mfumo: Presumptive tax inatumika kama: mapato yako ya mwaka ni TZS 4M–100M NA hujasajiliwa VAT NA huhitajiki kutunza vitabu kamili vya uhasibu. Mfumo wa kawaida (normal accounts) unatumika kama: mapato yako yanazidi TZS 100M, au umesajiliwa VAT, au mwajiri mkubwa wenye wajibu wa kuandaa hesabu zilizokaguliwa. Kwa TZS 80,000,000 bado unaweza kutumia presumptive ikiwa haujasajiliwa VAT. Lakini kama mapato yako yanakaribia TZS 100M, panga mpito kwa mfumo wa kawaida mapema.
answer_en: Criteria for choosing the system: Presumptive tax applies if: your annual turnover is TZS 4M–100M AND you are not VAT registered AND you are not required to maintain full accounting records. Normal accounts system applies if: your turnover exceeds TZS 100M, or you are VAT registered, or a large employer required to prepare audited accounts. At TZS 80,000,000 you can still use presumptive if not VAT registered. But if your revenue is approaching TZS 100M, plan the transition to the normal system in advance.
question_en: My small business has revenue of TZS 80,000,000 — how do I know whether to use presumptive tax or the normal system?
primary_source_name: TRA — presumptive vs normal tax system

question_sw: BRELA inaweza kufuta usajili wa kampuni baada ya miaka mingapi bila annual return?
answer_sw: BRELA inaweza kuanzisha mchakato wa kufuta kampuni kwenye rejesta kama haikuwasilisha annual return kwa miaka miwili au zaidi. Kabla ya kufuta, BRELA inatuma notisi za onyo. Ikiwa kampuni haijibu, inafutwa kwenye rejesta rasmi. Kampuni iliyofutwa inaweza kuomba kurejesha hali yake ndani ya kipindi fulani.
question_en: After how many years without an annual return can BRELA strike off a company?
answer_en: BRELA can initiate strike off proceedings if a company has not filed an annual return for two or more years. Before striking off, BRELA sends warning notices. If the company does not respond it is removed from the official register. A struck-off company can apply for restoration within a specified period.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: BRELA ina portal ya mtandaoni kwa ajili ya usajili? Ninawezaje kuitumia?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. BRELA ina mfumo wa usajili wa mtandaoni unaoruhusu usajili na uwasilishaji wa hati bila kuhitaji kwenda ofisi. Unaweza kufikia portal kupitia tovuti ya brela.go.tz. Hatua za kimsingi ni: tengeneza akaunti ya mtumiaji, chagua aina ya usajili unaotaka (kampuni, jina la biashara, ushirika), jaza fomu za mtandaoni, pakia hati zinazohitajika, lipa ada kupitia GePG au mfumo wa malipo ulioungwa mkono. Usajili wa mtandaoni unaokoa muda na safari. Kwa msaada wa kina, BRELA ina ofisi kuu Dar es Salaam na ofisi za kanda.
answer_en: Yes. BRELA has an online registration system that allows registration and document submission without needing to visit the office. You can access the portal through the BRELA website at brela.go.tz. The basic steps are: create a user account, select the type of registration you want (company, business name, partnership), complete the online forms, upload required documents, pay the fee via GePG or the supported payment system. Online registration saves time and travel. For detailed assistance, BRELA has its main office in Dar es Salaam and regional offices.
question_en: Does BRELA have an online portal for registration? How can I use it?

question_sw: Nambari ya rejesta ya malipo (PRN) ya TRA ni nini na ninaipata wapi?
answer_sw: PRN (Payment Reference Number) ni nambari ya kipekee inayotolewa na mfumo wa TRA baada ya kuwasilisha return au kutoa ombi la malipo. PRN inathibitisha kwamba malipo yanakwenda kwenye akaunti sahihi ya kodi sahihi. Unapata PRN kwa: kuwasilisha return yako kwenye IDRAS au portal ya TRA, ambapo PRN itatolewa moja kwa moja baada ya kuthibitisha return. Kisha unalipa kupitia GePG kwa kutumia PRN hiyo. Kila PRN ina muda wa kuisha (thibitisha muda halisi na TRA) — lipa kabla haijakwisha. Bila PRN sahihi, malipo yanaweza kutokwenda kwenye akaunti yako ya kodi.
answer_en: A PRN (Payment Reference Number) is a unique number issued by the TRA system after filing a return or making a payment request. The PRN confirms that payment is going to the correct tax account. You obtain a PRN by: filing your return on IDRAS or the TRA portal, where a PRN is generated automatically after confirming the return. You then pay via GePG using that PRN. Each PRN has an expiry period (confirm current duration with TRA) — pay before it expires. Without the correct PRN, payment may not reach your tax account.
question_en: What is a TRA payment reference number (PRN) and where do I get it?

question_sw: NSSF inanipatia nini mimi kama mfanyakazi baadaye?
answer_sw: NSSF inatoa mafao (benefits) mbalimbali kwa wanachama wake: Pensheni ya uzee (retirement pension) — ukifikia umri wa kustaafu. Mafao ya ulemavu (invalidity pension) — ukiwa huwezi kufanya kazi kwa ulemavu. Mafao ya mlezi (survivors pension) — kwa familia yako ukifa. Mafao ya mazishi (funeral grant) — msaada wa mazishi. Mafao ya uzazi (maternity benefit) — kwa wanawake wajawazito wanaohitimu. Kiasi cha mafao kinategemea michango yako na muda wa uanachama wako. Thibitisha mafao ya sasa na NSSF kwenye nssf.or.tz.
question_en: What benefits does NSSF give me as an employee in the future?
answer_en: NSSF provides various benefits to its members: Retirement pension — when you reach retirement age. Invalidity pension — if you become unable to work due to disability. Survivors pension — for your family if you pass away. Funeral grant — assistance with burial costs. Maternity benefit — for qualifying pregnant women members. The amount of benefits depends on your contributions and length of membership. Confirm current benefits with NSSF at nssf.or.tz.

instruction: Kampuni ya simu iliyoteuliwa na TRA inatoa certificate vipi kwa msambazaji?
output: Kampuni ya simu kama withholding agent inafanya hivi: inapokea invoice kutoka msambazaji aliyesajiliwa VAT, anakata sehemu ya VAT hiyo kulingana na kiwango kilichowekwa, analipia msambazaji kiasi kilichobakia, kisha anatoa certificate inayoonyesha kiasi alichokata. Certificate lazima itolewe siku ile ile VAT inakuwa payable — si tarehe 20. Tarehe 20 ni kwa ajili ya kupeleka withholding TRA.

question_sw: Mwajiri anahitaji usajili wa BRELA kabla ya kuomba TIN ya TRA — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si lazima kwa kila hali. Mtu binafsi (individual) anaweza kupata TIN bila kusajili kampuni na BRELA. Hata hivyo, kampuni au biashara iliyoundwa inapaswa kusajiliwa BRELA kwanza ili kupata TIN ya kampuni. TRA inahitaji ushahidi wa uwepo wa kisheria wa biashara (kama Cheti cha Uanzishwaji au usajili wa jina la biashara).
question_en: Is BRELA registration required before applying for a TRA TIN — is this true?
answer_en: Not for every case. An individual can obtain a personal TIN without BRELA registration. However, an incorporated company or registered business should be registered with BRELA first to get a company TIN. TRA requires evidence of the business's legal existence (such as Certificate of Incorporation or business name registration).
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: Nikilinganisha viwango vya VAT Kenya na Tanzania — Tanzania ina viwango vingapi?
output: Tanzania: viwango VITATU. Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Kenya (kwa ulinganisho): 0%, 8% (bidhaa chache kama petroli), 16% (standard). Tofauti muhimu: Tanzania HAINA 8% wala 5% — viwango vya Kenya havitumiki Tanzania. Usijaribu kutumia viwango vya Kenya kwa biashara yako Tanzania.

question_sw: Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha mshahara chini ya GN 605A ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha juu kabisa ni TZS 765,900 kwa mwezi — inayohusu sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati. Hii ni kiwango cha chini; waajiri wanaweza kulipa zaidi. Thibitisha sekta yako na MLYWF.
question_en: What is the highest minimum wage under GN 605A?
answer_en: The highest minimum wage is TZS 765,900 per month — applicable to the international mining and energy sector. This is a floor; employers may pay above this. Confirm your sector with MLYWF.

question_sw: SDL na OSHA — ni sheria zinazoathiriana?
answer_sw: Hapana moja kwa moja. SDL (Skills Development Levy) ni ushuru wa TRA unaohusiana na mafunzo ya ujuzi wa kazi. OSHA inasimamia usalama na afya mahali pa kazi. Ni sheria mbili tofauti zenye madhumuni tofauti. Kufuata OSHA hakukuondolei wajibu wa SDL, na kinyume chake.
question_en: SDL and OSHA — are they interconnected laws?
answer_en: Not directly. SDL (Skills Development Levy) is a TRA levy related to job skills training. OSHA governs occupational health and safety. They are two different laws with different purposes. OSHA compliance does not remove your SDL obligation, and vice versa.

question_sw: PAYE inahesabiwaje kwa mfanyakazi wa saa — analipwa TZS 3,000 kwa saa na anafanya kazi masaa 80 kwa mwezi?
answer_sw: Mshahara wa mwezi: 80 saa × TZS 3,000 = TZS 240,000. Kwa sababu TZS 240,000 iko chini ya kiwango cha kwanza cha PAYE cha TZS 270,000 (0%), na pia ni chini ya kiwango ambacho punguzo la kibinafsi kinaweza kufikia, PAYE = TZS 0. Mwajiri hahitajiki kukata PAYE kwa mwezi huo. Hata hivyo, ikiwa mfanyakazi huyu ana ajira nyingine na jumla ya mapato yake yanazidi TZS 559,000 kwa mwezi, atakuwa na PAYE ya kulipa kupitia return yake ya mtu binafsi.
answer_en: Monthly salary: 80 hours × TZS 3,000 = TZS 240,000. Since TZS 240,000 falls within the first PAYE band at TZS 270,000 (0%), and is also below the level where personal relief can reach, PAYE = TZS 0. The employer does not need to deduct PAYE that month. However, if this employee has other employment and their total income exceeds TZS 559,000 per month, they will have PAYE to pay through their individual tax return.
question_en: How is PAYE calculated for an hourly worker — paid TZS 3,000 per hour and works 80 hours per month?

question_sw: Kampuni inaweza kufutwa (struck off) kwenye rejesta ya BRELA ikiwa haitofanya nini?
answer_sw: Kampuni inaweza kufutwa kwenye rejesta ya BRELA ikiwa: (1) haikuwasilisha annual return kwa miaka miwili au zaidi, (2) iliomba kufutwa mwenyewe (voluntary strike off), au (3) ikiwa kuna ushahidi kwamba haifanyi biashara. Kufutwa hakumaanisha kuondoa wajibu wote wa kisheria wa kampuni.
question_en: A company can be struck off the BRELA register if it fails to do what?
answer_en: A company can be struck off the BRELA register if: (1) it has not filed annual returns for two or more years, (2) it applies for voluntary strike off, or (3) there is evidence that it is not carrying on business. Strike off does not remove all legal liabilities of the company.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni aliye Tanzania kwa visa ya utalii anaweza kuanza kazi bila kibali?
answer_sw: Hapana kabisa. Visa ya utalii (tourist visa) hairuhusiwi kwa ajili ya kufanya kazi Tanzania. Mtu aliye Tanzania kwa visa ya utalii na anafanya kazi yoyote inayolipwa anakiuka sheria ya uhamiaji. Kabla ya kuanza kazi, mfanyakazi wa kigeni lazima apate kibali sahihi cha kazi kutoka Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: Can a foreigner on a tourist visa in Tanzania start working without a permit?
answer_en: Absolutely not. A tourist visa does not permit working in Tanzania. A person in Tanzania on a tourist visa who performs any paid work is in violation of immigration law. Before commencing employment a foreign worker must obtain the correct work permit from the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Mwanasheria alisema SDL inamaanisha "Statutory Deduction Levy". Je, hii ni jina sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Jina sahihi ni Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi kwa Kiswahili — inayosimamiwa na TRA. "Statutory Deduction Levy" si jina halisi la kodi yoyote ya Tanzania. SDL inalipwa na mwajiri peke yake (si kukatwa mshahara) kwa asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara, kwa wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi.
question_en: A lawyer said SDL means "Statutory Deduction Levy". Is that the correct name?
answer_en: No. The correct name is Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi in Swahili — administered by TRA. "Statutory Deduction Levy" is not a real name for any Tanzanian levy. SDL is paid by the employer only (not deducted from wages) at 3.5% of gross payroll, for employers with 10 or more employees.

instruction: Dawa za binadamu zinaingizwa Tanzania — je, zina VAT au exemption?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Hali ya VAT kwa dawa za binadamu — kama zimesamehewa, zero-rated, au zinaapply msamaha maalum — ni mada inayohusisha Jedwali la VAT Act la Tanzania ambapo baadhi ya dawa zimeorodheshwa tofauti. Hii inahitaji uchambuzi wa kina wa kisheria nje ya wigo wangu wa biashara ya kawaida. Wasiliana na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz au mshauri wa kodi wa sekta ya afya kwa jibu sahihi.

instruction: Mfanyakazi wangu anafanya kazi katika sekta ya madini ya kimataifa — kiwango cha mshahara wake wa chini ni TZS ngapi chini ya GN 605A?
output: Kwa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati (international mining and energy), kiwango cha mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni karibu TZS 765,900 kwa mwezi. Hii ndiyo kiwango cha JUU KABISA katika GN 605A — si wastani. Wastani wa sekta zote ni TZS 358,322 — kwa hivyo mfanyakazi wa madini ya kimataifa ana haki ya mshahara zaidi ya wastani. Hakikisha unalipa angalau TZS 765,900 kwa mfanyakazi huyu, si TZS 358,322 tu. Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

instruction: Mgeni ana gari moja la usafirishaji wa abiria (bajaj au taxi) — je, GN 487A inahusika?
output: Ndiyo — usafirishaji mdogo wa abiria ni mojawapo ya shughuli 15 zilizopigwa marufuku kwa wageni chini ya GN 487A (tarehe 28 Julai 2025). Hii inajumuisha gari moja la taxi, bajaj, na usafirishaji mdogo wa abiria. Idadi ya magari haibadilishi hali — hata gari moja linalotumiwa kwa biashara ya usafirishaji linakiuka GN 487A kama mmiliki ni mgeni. Adhabu: faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu — thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa hali yako maalum. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mgeni Tanzania — analazimika pia kuchangia NSSF?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. NSSF inachangiwa na wafanyakazi WOTE wanaofanya kazi Tanzania — wakiwemo wageni wenye vibali vya kazi halali. Mwajiri analipa 10% na mfanyakazi anachangia 10% (jumla 20%) ya mshahara wa msingi. Hata hivyo, wafanyakazi wa muda mfupi au wa secondment wanaweza kuwa na hali maalum — thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: A foreign employee in Tanzania — must they also contribute to NSSF?
answer_en: Yes. NSSF contributions are made by ALL employees working in Tanzania — including foreigners with valid work permits. The employer pays 10% and the employee contributes 10% (20% combined) of basic salary. However, short-term or secondment employees may have special status — verify with NSSF.

question_sw: Adhabu ya GN 487A inaanza lini — tangu wakati wa kukamatwa au baada ya hukumu ya korti?
answer_sw: Adhabu rasmi (faini, kifungo, visa kufutwa) zinaanza baada ya HUKUMU ya korti — si wakati wa kukamatwa au kushitakiwa. Wakati wa kukamatwa (arrest), mgeni anaweza kuwekwa kizuizini (remand) hadi kesi iishe. Kizuizini kabla ya hukumu ni tofauti na kifungo cha adhabu — ingawa mara nyingi muda wa kizuizini huhesabiwa katika jumla ya adhabu ya jela.
question_en: When does a GN 487A penalty begin — from the time of arrest or after a court judgement?
answer_en: Formal penalties (fine, imprisonment, visa revocation) begin AFTER a court JUDGEMENT — not at time of arrest or charging. At the time of arrest, the non-citizen may be held in remand custody until the case concludes. Pre-judgement remand is different from a punitive prison sentence — though the remand period is often counted against the total prison sentence.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Kampuni mpya yenye wafanyakazi 15 Tanzania inahitaji kusajili OSHA na WCF wakati mmoja au hatua kwa hatua?
answer_sw: Kampuni mpya yenye wafanyakazi 15 Tanzania inahitaji kusajili VYOMBO VYOTE haraka iwezekanavyo. Mpangilio wa vitendo: (1) BRELA + TIN (kwanza), (2) NSSF (wakati wa kuajiri wafanyakazi wa kwanza), (3) WCF (wakati wa kuajiri wafanyakazi wa kwanza — mwajiri mwenye hata mfanyakazi 1 anahitaji WCF), (4) OSHA (mara idadi ya wafanyakazi ifikia 10). Usisimame mpaka wafanyakazi 15 kusajili OSHA — usajili unatakiwa mapema unapofikia kizingiti cha 10.
question_en: Does a new company with 15 employees in Tanzania need to register with OSHA and WCF at the same time or step by step?
answer_en: A new company with 15 employees in Tanzania needs to register with ALL bodies as quickly as possible. Practical sequence: (1) BRELA + TIN (first), (2) NSSF (when hiring the first employee), (3) WCF (when hiring the first employee — even an employer with 1 worker needs WCF), (4) OSHA (once the employee count reaches 10). Do not wait until 15 employees to register with OSHA — registration is required as soon as you hit the threshold of 10.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Jinsi ya kuhesabu PAYE ya mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa Shilingi 400,000 kwa mwezi?
answer_sw: Kwa mshahara wa Shilingi 400,000: Kanda ya 0%: Shilingi 270,000 → kodi sifuri. Kanda ya 8%: Shilingi 270,001–400,000 = Shilingi 130,000 × 8% = Shilingi 10,400. Jumla ya PAYE = Shilingi 10,400 kwa mwezi.
question_en: How to calculate PAYE for an employee earning TZS 400,000 per month?
answer_en: For a salary of TZS 400,000: 0% band: TZS 270,000 → zero tax. 8% band: TZS 270,001–400,000 = TZS 130,000 × 8% = TZS 10,400. Total PAYE = TZS 10,400 per month.

instruction: Mwenzangu alisema BRELA ina aina 16 za biashara — ni kweli?
output: Hapana, si kweli. BRELA inasajili aina TATU za biashara: 1. Biashara ya jina (sole trader/business name) 2. Ubia (partnership) 3. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company). Hakuna aina nyingine ya nne au ya tano chini ya Companies Act Tanzania. Nambari ya 16 haikuwa sahihi — inaweza kuwa imetoka kwa chanzo kibaya au uelewa mbaya wa kategoria ndogo za kibiashara. Chanzo rasmi pekee ni brela.go.tz.

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya WHT kwa malipo ya ndani na malipo ya nje ya nchi ni nini?
answer_sw: WHT kwa malipo ya NDANI (wakazi) mara nyingi ina kiwango cha chini — kwa mfano, ada za usimamizi 5%, ada za mkurugenzi 15%. WHT kwa malipo ya NJE (wasio wakazi) ina kiwango cha juu zaidi — ada za usimamizi 15%, ada za mkurugenzi 15%, kodi ya pango 20%. Gawio na riba ni sawa kwa wote (10%). Mikataba ya DTA inaweza kupunguza viwango vya wasio wakazi.
question_en: What is the difference between WHT on domestic payments and cross-border payments?
answer_en: WHT on DOMESTIC (resident) payments generally has lower rates — management fees 5%, director fees 15%. WHT on CROSS-BORDER (non-resident) payments has higher rates — management fees 15%, director fees 15%, rent 20%. Dividends and interest are the same for both (10%). Double Taxation Agreements (DTAs) can reduce non-resident rates.

question_sw: Bendi za PAYE za Tanzania kwa mwaka 2025/2026 ni zipi — zitaje zote tano kwa usahihi?
answer_sw: Bendi tano za PAYE Tanzania 2025/2026: (1) TZS 0 hadi 270,000: kiwango 0%; (2) TZS 270,001 hadi 520,000: kiwango 8% (si 9%); (3) TZS 520,001 hadi 760,000: kiwango 20%; (4) TZS 760,001 hadi 1,000,000: kiwango 25%; (5) Zaidi ya TZS 1,000,000: kiwango 30%. Kizingiti cha mapato yasiyotozwa kodi: TZS 3,240,000/mwaka (TZS 270,000/mwezi kwa 0% — imejengwa ndani ya Bendi 1, hakuna punguzo tofauti la kila mwezi). Kodi inazingatiwa kwenye KIPATO KINACHOPITA kizingiti cha kila bendi — si kwenye mshahara wote.
question_en: What are Tanzania's PAYE bands for 2025/2026 — list all five accurately?
answer_en: Five PAYE bands for Tanzania 2025/2026: (1) TZS 0 to 270,000: rate 0%; (2) TZS 270,001 to 520,000: rate 8% (not 9%); (3) TZS 520,001 to 760,000: rate 20%; (4) TZS 760,001 to 1,000,000: rate 25%; (5) Above TZS 1,000,000: rate 30%. Monthly Annual tax-free threshold: TZS 3,240,000/year (TZS 270,000/month at 0% — built into Band 1, no separate monthly relief).. Tax applies to income ABOVE each band threshold — not on the total salary.

instruction: TRA wamenishuku kwa transfer pricing — ukaguzi wa transfer pricing unafanyika vipi na ninaweza kujilinda vipi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ukaguzi wa transfer pricing unafanyika chini ya Income Tax Act — TRA inaweza kupinga bei za miamala ya washirika na kutoa marekebisho ya kodi iwapo bei hazilingani na bei ya soko. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kampuni inayolipa ada za kitaalamu kwa daktari au mwanasheria wa nje (freelance) ya Tanzania haishikili kodi yoyote — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Malipo ya ada za kitaalamu kwa mtu wa Tanzania (daktari, mwanasheria, mhasibu wa kujitegemea) yanashikiliwa kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 5 (WHT kwa mkazi). Kampuni inayolipa ada hizi ina wajibu wa kushikilia WHT kabla ya kulipa na kuwasilisha na TRA ndani ya siku 7 baada ya mwisho wa mwezi. Kushindwa kushikilia kunafanya kampuni iwajibike kwa kodi, riba, na adhabu.
question_en: A company paying professional fees to a freelance Tanzanian doctor or lawyer does not withhold any tax — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Payments of professional fees to a Tanzania person (doctor, lawyer, independent accountant) are subject to 5% withholding tax (WHT for resident). The company paying these fees has an obligation to withhold WHT before paying and remit to TRA within 7 days after month end. Failing to withhold makes the company liable for the tax, interest, and penalties.

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kutoa punguzo (discount) kwa mteja anayekataa risiti?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kutoa punguzo au bei tofauti kwa wateja wanaokataa risiti ni njia ya kukwepa kodi na ni kinyume cha sheria. Risiti ya EFD ni wajibu wa kisheria — si bidhaa inayoweza kutoa punguzo. Bei moja ina VAT na EFD — huwezi kutoa bei mbili: moja 'na risiti' na nyingine 'bila risiti'. TRA inaona tabia hii kama ukwepaji wa kodi.
question_en: Can I give a discount to a customer who refuses the receipt?
answer_en: No. Offering a discount or different price to customers who refuse receipts is a form of tax evasion and is illegal. An EFD receipt is a legal obligation — not a tradable product. One price includes VAT and EFD — you cannot offer two prices: one 'with receipt' and another 'without receipt'. TRA views this behaviour as tax evasion.

instruction: Nikiwasilisha risiti ya EFD kwa malipo ya kawaida tu — malipo ya simu ninaweza kuacha?
output: Malipo ya simu (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money) yanahitaji risiti ya EFD kama malipo ya kawaida. Njia ya malipo haiathiri wajibu wa kutoa risiti — kila muamala wa mauzo lazima upate risiti ya EFD. Huwezi kuacha malipo ya simu — lazima utoe risiti ya EFD kwa KILA mauzo. Ukiacha malipo ya simu bila risiti ya EFD, unafanya ukiukaji wa sheria ya kodi, ambao unaweza kusababisha faini ya TRA.

instruction: Wakurugenzi wa kampuni wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi kwa faini za EFD?
output: Ndiyo — TRA ina uwezo wa kufuatilia wakurugenzi na maafisa wa kampuni kibinafsi kwa makosa ya makusudi ya kodi, ikiwa ni pamoja na ukiukwaji wa EFD. Hasa: kama kampuni imeendesha biashara kwa makusudi bila EFD au kutoa risiti bandia — wakurugenzi wanaohusika wanaweza kushikiliwa kibinafsi kwa: (1) Madeni ya kodi + faini ya kampuni; (2) Mashtaka ya jinai ya ukwepaji wa kodi. Hata kama kampuni ni ya hisa (limited liability), ulaghai wa kodi na ukwepaji wa makusudi unaweza kuondoa ulinzi wa limited liability. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na mshauri wa kodi.

question_sw: Tulikosa kulipa SDL kwa miezi 3. TRA wanaweza kufanya nini?
answer_sw: Kukosa kulipa SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — kwa miezi 3 ni ukiukaji wa makubaliano wa ushuru. TRA inaweza: (1) Kutoza riba kwa kila mwezi wa ucheleweshaji; (2) Kuamua faini za ziada; (3) Kufanya ukaguzi wa malipo yote ya payroll; (4) Kutoa tathmini rasmi ya madeni; (5) Kuchukua hatua za kisheria ikiwa madeni hayatatuliwi. Wasiliana na TRA mara moja ili kutathmini hali na kupanga malipo ya madeni.
question_en: We missed paying SDL for 3 months. What can TRA do?
answer_en: Failing to pay SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — for 3 months is a tax compliance violation. TRA may: (1) Charge interest for each month of delay; (2) Impose additional penalties; (3) Conduct a full payroll audit; (4) Issue a formal assessment of arrears; (5) Take legal action if arrears are not settled. Contact TRA immediately to assess the situation and arrange a payment plan.

question_sw: Mwajiri aliniambia: "tuna wafanyakazi 10 lakini mmoja yuko likizoni, kwa hivyo tumehesabu kwa 9." Je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mfanyakazi aliye likizoni bado ni mfanyakazi wako — anahesabika katika jumla ya wafanyakazi kwa SDL. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — inategemea wafanyakazi wote wanaolipwa, ikiwemo wale wanaolipwa wakati wa likizo. Kampuni yenye wafanyakazi 10 (mmoja likizoni bado analipwa) inalazimika kulipa SDL kwa asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara.
question_en: An employer told me: "we have 10 employees but one is on leave, so we calculated for 9." Is this correct?
answer_en: No. An employee on leave is still your employee — they count in the total for SDL purposes. SDL — Skills Development Levy (Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) — depends on all employees on payroll, including those being paid while on leave. A company with 10 employees (one on paid leave still counted) is required to pay SDL at 3.5% of total gross payroll.

instruction: Kampuni ya EPZ na kampuni ya Tanzania Bara ya kawaida — tofauti kubwa za kodi ni zipi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Ulinganisho wa mfumo wa kodi kati ya EPZ/SEZ na kampuni za kawaida za Tanzania Bara unashughulikiwa chini ya EPZ Act na mikataba ya EPZA — ni uchambuzi mgumu unaohitaji mshauri maalum wa uwekezaji. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, EFD, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kodi ya awali (provisional tax) ya kampuni inakokotolewa vipi?
answer_sw: Kodi ya awali inakokotolewa kwa njia mbili zinazoruhusiwa: (1) Mbinu ya mwaka uliopita: kila awamu = kodi halisi ya mwaka uliopita ÷ 4. Hii ni njia rahisi lakini inaweza kulazimisha ulipie zaidi ikiwa faida imeshuka. (2) Mbinu ya makisio ya mwaka huu: kampuni inakadiri faida ya mwaka huu na kuhesabu kodi inayotarajiwa, kisha inagawanya katika awamu 4. Njia hii inafaa zaidi ikiwa mwaka huu una mabadiliko makubwa ya faida. Kampuni inaweza kuwasilisha makisio yaliyorekebishwa (revised estimates) ikiwa hali inabadilika. Makisio lazima yawasilishwe kwenye tarehe za awamu.
answer_en: Provisional tax is calculated using two permitted methods: (1) Prior year method: each instalment = prior year actual tax ÷ 4. This is straightforward but may lead to overpayment if profit has declined. (2) Current year estimate method: the company estimates current year profit and calculates expected tax, then divides into 4 instalments. This method is more appropriate if the current year has significant profit changes. A company may submit revised estimates if circumstances change. Estimates must be filed by the instalment due dates.
question_en: How is a company's provisional tax calculated?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — provisional tax calculation methods

instruction: Kampuni inayosambaza bidhaa nyingi kwa serikali — inaweza kusajiliwa kama qualifying buyer wenyewe?
output: Kampuni ya kibinafsi inayosambaza bidhaa kwa serikali HAIWEZI kujisajilisha mwenyewe kama qualifying buyer. Qualifying buyers ni: (1) Wizara ya Fedha moja kwa moja; (2) Taasisi za serikali zinazoweka mapato yao; (3) Mtu/taasisi iliyoteuliwa na Commissioner General wa TRA kwa tangazo rasmi. Kampuni ya kibinafsi (hata msambazaji mkubwa wa serikali) haijateuliwa moja kwa moja. Hata hivyo, kama kampuni inauza bidhaa kwa wizara — WIZARA (qualifying buyer) ndiyo inayokata withholding, si kampuni ya kibinafsi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: GN 487A ilianza rasmi tarehe ngapi?
answer_sw: GN 487A ilianza rasmi tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Baadaye, Idara ya Uhamiaji iliendesha operesheni ya utekelezaji kuanzia Septemba 11 hadi Oktoba 8, 2025. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
question_en: When did GN 487A officially come into effect?
answer_en: GN 487A officially came into effect on 28 July 2025. Subsequently, the Immigration Services Department conducted an enforcement exercise from 11 September to 8 October 2025. Confirm with the Immigration Department.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A (GN 487A) - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025

instruction: Kizingiti cha usajilishaji wa VAT Tanzania ni ngapi kwa sasa hivi?
output: Kizingiti cha usajilishaji wa VAT ni TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka (miezi 12 inayozunguka) AU TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6 yoyote mfululizo. Mauzo yoyote yanayozidi kizingiti hiki — kwa kipindi chochote kinachozunguka — yanalazimisha usajilishaji. Thibitisha kizingiti cha sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Nikiwa kumwajiri wafanyakazi, OSHA inataka nini kutoka kwangu mara tu?
output: Mara tu unapoanza kumwajiri: (1) sajili mahali pako pa kazi na OSHA (osha.go.tz); (2) fanya tathmini ya hatari za usalama mahali pa kazi; (3) andaa sera ya usalama na afya; (4) hakikisha vifaa vya usalama vipo — kinga za moto, msaada wa kwanza, n.k.; (5) mpe mfanyakazi mafunzo ya usalama. Usisalie bila usajilishaji wa OSHA — adhabu zinaanza tangu siku ya kwanza ya ukiukwaji.
